title: Noeis: reading that compounds
description: Bring in your Kindle highlights, Readwise, books and saved links. Noeis connects each new thing you read to what you already know, and grows a wiki of your own that cites every source.
headline: Everything you read should add up.
lede: Most of what you read is gone in a month. Noeis keeps it, connects each new book, article and highlight to what you have read before, and writes it into a wiki of your own that cites every source. The hundredth thing you read lands on the ninety-nine before it.

statements.title: Bring in what you have already read.
statements.copy: Kindle highlights, Readwise, the books you are reading, links you saved. Years of reading arrive on the first day, not one article at a time.

statements.title: Each new thing lands on the old.
statements.copy: Save an article or type a line from a book, and Noeis shows the passages it echoes or argues with across everything you have read, quoted, with the source.

statements.title: A wiki that grows as you read.
statements.copy: Ask for a page on anything you have read about. It is written from your highlights and notes, cites them, and says where two sources disagree. The more you bring in, the more it has to stand on.

statements.title: Ask, and get your own reading back.
statements.copy: Questions are answered from your library with the quote. When your reading has nothing on it, Noeis says so instead of guessing. Connect Claude Code, Codex and other agents, read-only unless you grant more.
